api_visual_input.ten_second24fps_example: 12 sampled positions out of approximately240 frames; not continuous playback or proof all frames inspected.

agent_visual_input.implementation: Configured/authorized CLI execution with credential-free acceptance_task.manifest/image/sample MCP tools. Media copied into isolated task folder with SHAs, actual image-read receipts required.

ai: Key pose/direction/prop contact versus sampled reference
manual: Full playback: order/speed/stops/transitions, body/prop jumps, occlusion/disappearance

defect_coverage_limits.action: Sampled key-pose triage, not full sequence/tempo proof. Reference video0+midpoint can omit key actions.
defect_coverage_limits.palette: Can suggest a visible cast in supplied frames, but RGB/JPEG/resized evidence is not exact per-pixel palette/Alpha measurement.
defect_coverage_limits.tail_appendage: May detect clear protrusion if sampled and visible; cannot certify absence in unprovided frames or occluded skirt region.
defect_coverage_limits.flicker: Transient moving lighting or single-frame artifact may fall between12samples; keep all-frame numeric gates and real playback/targeted independent QA.

assistant_attachment_caveat: Visual assistant accepts video/audio assets for reference metadata, but _message_input explicitly does not parse/transcribe their contents; only image assets enter actual vision inputs.
recommended_use_without_claiming_full_ac: Once an authorized fixed reviewer exists, use sampled AI results as triage to prioritize failed/pending IDs and targeted source-frame intervals. Preserve independent SHA-bound source anatomy review, all-frame alpha/background tests, and actual continuous-playback instrumentation/manual continuity checks. This audit did not authorize or activate such a reviewer.
